updatePolicy: Compare each patched source and generated browser/minified entry against the recorded upstream tarball; rerun root regression and full build before updating. Restore registry packages only when all listed issues have an upstream fix.

distributionScope.retained: Complete public runtime/API and build sources, licenses and provenance; root security and compatibility tests exercise installed entrypoints.
distributionScope.reason: Upstream-only tests/examples/build-tool configuration are not used by this repository or by the package runtime. Old embedded framework copies are not needed to preserve benchmark execution or the Angular legacy jQuery matrix.

securitySourceDiff.scope: All runtime source changes (AMD src and full distribution) against the integrity-verified upstream tarball; min/maps regenerated by scripts/rebuild-security-vendor.cjs.
